text.tspan: Persistent Catalog Cache: Trust and Publication Protocol
The cache is an optional projection of a published database snapshot. It is verified local input, never catalog authority.
server catalogs and auxiliary sections remain live/lazy memory structures

file exists; compressed-size bound; SHA-256; bounded gunzip

live hydrate only if network policy allows
